lenses.name: Free user at a limit
lenses.focus: A free user who has just hit a limit, a paywall, or a locked item, or would if the app had one. What do they want right now that a rewarded play could give them, partially and for a while?

lenses.name: Subscriber
lenses.focus: A paying user. What do they still lack or want more of that an opt-in rewarded play could add without devaluing what they pay for? If the app has no subscription, take its most engaged user.

lenses.name: Drifting user
lenses.focus: A user whose visits are thinning out. What would bring them back or protect progress they would lose, through a rewarded play at a natural moment rather than an interruption?
